      "body": "Two normalizers in this PR; only the SSE one protects free-form data\n\n`normalizeTrailEventValue` (`trail_watch_cmd.go`) deliberately exempts the free-form key so event data is not re-cased:\n\n```go\nif key == \"payload\" {\n    out[key] = child\n    continue\n}\n```\n\n`normalizeTrailJSONValue` here has no equivalent guard — it re-cases every key at every depth, on both the read path (`decodeNormalizedTrailJSON`, used by ~13 UnmarshalJSON methods across trail/review/thread types) and the write path (`legacyTrailRequestBody`, which every request body on the **default** backend passes through).\n\nVerified against this head (512908dc6):\n\n```\nread   {\"id\":\"t1\",\"context\":{\"my_custom_key\":1},\"labels\":{\"team_a\":true}}\n    -\u003e {\"id\":\"t1\",\"context\":{\"myCustomKey\":1},\"labels\":{\"teamA\":true}}\n\nwrite  {\"metadata\":{\"userDefinedKey\":1,\"already_snake\":2}}\n    -\u003e {\"metadata\":{\"user_defined_key\":1,\"already_snake\":2}}\n```\n\n**Latent, not live:** no trail type currently declares a `map[string]any`; the only free-form field is `TrailApproval.Author` (`json.RawMessage`), and re-casing an author object is harmless.
